name: datasetUpload.py
summary: DRF serializer that validates and processes incoming dataset file uploads before persistence.
purpose: To encapsulate dataset upload validation logic, ensuring only valid files and metadata reach the view and model layers, while shielding the application from malformed or malicious upload payloads.
responsibilities: Validate incoming multipart upload data and file metadata
Perform file-level checks (extension, size, existence) using os utilities
Serialize and deserialize between Dataset model instances and native Python types
Transform and sanitize upload paths before storage
Raise structured validation errors back to the view layer
inputs: Multipart form-data containing the dataset file
outputs: Validated native Python dictionary ready for model creation
Dataset model instance on successful save/update
DRF ValidationError with field-level error messages on failure
architecture_notes: Implements the DRF Serializer pattern to enforce a strict validation boundary between the view (dataset/views.py) and the persistence layer. The use of the os module suggests direct filesystem path manipulation, indicating a thin abstraction over local storage rather than a pluggable storage backend. This design centralizes upload rules in one class, making it easier to maintain consistent validation across multiple views or API versions.
improvements: Replace direct os.path usage with Django's default_storage or a dedicated storage backend abstraction to improve portability and testability
Extract file validation (size, magic bytes, virus scan) into a reusable validator class or service layer
Add asynchronous task offloading for large dataset ingestion to prevent request-blocking
Introduce explicit file type whitelisting via MIME-type detection rather than relying solely on extensions
Remove file path construction from the serializer and delegate it to the model's upload_to callable or a dedicated file service
